title: Applying a Framed Action
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine, choose one of its work tapes as the clock tape, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For any six-tape configuration $c$, tape contents and head positions for the original $M$-tapes, and six-tape action $a$, applying the framed action to the framed configuration gives the frame of the configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: contents and head positions for the $M$ tapes
replaced:
Applying the framed lift of a six-tape action to a framed configuration equals
the frame of the six-tape configuration obtained by applying the action; the
inactive lanes of the old block are unchanged.
